reason: We just finished moving off E-Golf4U, the volunteers are exhausted and the members have only just learned the new system. I'm not putting the club through another migration within a year, least of all onto something that isn't even live at its first pilot club.
objection: Two founders, an AI-built product and no club actually running on it yet. If they quit or get hit by a bus, what happens to the data of 950 members, our invoicing and our tee sheet? I'd be explaining that to the general meeting.
would_change_my_mind: A few clubs our size running on it for a full season without trouble, plus a contractual escrow or full data-export guarantee if they stop, and then talk to me again when our current contract comes up for renewal.
